simple.summary: נָצַץ (nâtsats) means to glare , i.e. be bright-colored First listed occurrence: Ezek 1 7.

definitions.full: H5340. natsats I. [ נָצַץ ] verb shine, sparkle (Late Hebrew נִצְנֵץ ; akin to Arabic sparkle, flash , נְעָא ᵑ7 ); — Qal Participle נְחשֶׁת כְּעֵין וְנֹצְצִים Ezek 1:7 (of cherubim); — Perles Anal.45 proposes נוֺצִיצָם their plumage ( ׳נ || form of נוֺצָה ), compare Ew.
